title: Final rewind step
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean inputs, let $r$ be a natural number, and let $C$ be an augmented configuration whose phase is rewind at index $j$ and counter $c$, where $0\le j\le r$ and $0\le c\le r+1$. If $j$ is not less than $r$, then for every Boolean word $w$, running the amplified machine from $C$ on either the word formed by prefixing $w$ with true or the word formed by prefixing it with false yields the same configuration: the configuration obtained from $C$ by halting and appending the Boolean value of the decision function at $c$ to its output.
